evals.name: seeded-errors-polish
evals.prompt: Zweryfikuj raport fixture/raport.md wobec źródeł w fixture/sources/. Chcę mieć pewność, że każde twierdzenie ma pokrycie w źródłach.
evals.expected_output: Claim registry covering all claims; both seeded errors found (31 dni vs 21 days in Nowak; sampling 'za filtrem z linii tłocznej' vs 'return line before the filter' in Schmidt); every verdict has pasted quote evidence; no false accusations against the ~10 correct claims; quantified closing statement with stop criteria.
assertions: Detects seeded error 1: '31 dni' vs 21 days in Nowak 2023
Detects seeded error 2: sampling location reversed vs Schmidt 2024 ('return line before the filter')
No false accusations against correct claims
Every reported error backed by a verbatim source quote
Claim registry artifact with per-claim verdicts exists

evals.name: recurring-errors-complaint
evals.prompt: I reviewed fixture/raport.md against the two source papers in fixture/sources/ twice already and each time I find new mistakes. Check it properly this time so I know when it's actually done.
evals.expected_output: Same detection as eval 0, plus explicit convergence guarantees: completeness test result, stop criteria status, residual-error statement; the answer explains WHY this verification converges unlike ad hoc re-reading.
assertions: Detects seeded error 1: '31 dni' vs 21 days in Nowak 2023
Detects seeded error 2: sampling location reversed vs Schmidt 2024 ('return line before the filter')
No false accusations against correct claims
Every reported error backed by a verbatim source quote
Claim registry artifact with per-claim verdicts exists
Addresses 'when is it done': explicit stop criteria / completeness evidence
